mapper.insert: insert into orders (id, user_id, pay_amount, pay_method, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{payAmount}, #{payMethod}, 0, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, now(), now())

insert into order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, price, quantity, pay_price) values (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{payPrice})
mapper.select: select * from orders where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update orders set status = 4, cancel_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
update orders set status = 5, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in (1, 2, 3)
update orders set status = 1,update_time = now(),pay_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0 and user_id = #{userId}
